# Contact Sheet Analysis

## 1) Visual Medium
**Roblox** animation/game footage (blocky avatars, Roblox-style faces and environments). UI elements visible: TikTok like/comment/share icons, heart, comment bubble, arrow, view counts.

## 2) On-Screen Text (frame by frame)
1. *(no readable text)* — group of avatars on street
2. "1K views" (top); "meme" (caption); "@larpniverse" (username); "while they were out partying... #huss" (caption); "1.1K" (share count)
3. "HUSS!" ; hoodie text: "in this town! beyond the rules"
4. "pushup" (caption)
5. *(faint watermark only)* — town square dance scene
6. "in this town!" / "beyond the rules" (hoodie text)
7. "@kevin_huss"; "while they were out partying... #huss"; "1.2M" likes; "8K" comments; "40K" shares
8. "potholes" (caption); "@mayor_official"; "while they were out partying, I was fixing the potholes"; "2.1M" likes; "19K" comments; "80K" shares
9. "than" (caption); hoodie: "in this town! beyond the rules"
10. "more" (caption)
11. "one" (caption); hoodie: "in this town! beyond the rules"; "@larpniverse"; "I was making a new one"
12. "that's" (caption); "1K" (share count)

## 3) Visual Arc
- **Frames 1–2:** daytime street group scene → dark night scene with an avatar playing basketball.
- **Frames 3, 6, 9, 11–12:** repeated close-ups of the blue star-capped avatar ("HUSS") in blue hoodie — happy in day frames, crying/tearful in frame 9, dark night in frame 12.
- **Frames 4–5:** interiors/activities — avatar doing a "pushup" on a mat, then a daytime dance party in a town square with bunting flags and speakers.
- **Frames 7–8:** competing characters — a red-hatted avatar (@kevin_huss) and a top-hatted mayor avatar (@mayor_official) at podiums with huge like counts.
- **Frame 10:** avatar next to a speaker in the party square.
- Palette shifts from bright day (blues, greens, colorful bunting) to dark night bookends.

## 4) Usernames/Watermarks
- **@larpniverse** (recurring, incl. faint watermark)
- **@kevin_huss**
- **@mayor_official**

## 5) Story Guess
A Roblox town meme trend: while everyone was out partying, the diligent character "Huss" (or the mayor) stayed behind doing pushups and fixing potholes — and that's one more "in this town!" tribute to them.
